name: virtuoso
description: Provider-based governance & dispatch suite: roadmap planning, execution discipline, close-outs, mid-dispatch decisions, audits, and doc hygiene — driven by a per-project registry that declares its live work register, terminal ledger, ownership rules, and permitted mutations.

interface.shortDescription: Governance and dispatch discipline for agent-run projects
interface.longDescription: Use Virtuoso to plan a roadmap, dispatch work at a declared effort level, decide mid-dispatch without losing the thread, close out against a terminal ledger, audit third-party code, and keep project documentation honest — all driven by a per-project registry that declares where the work lives and what may change it.
defaultPrompt: Set this project up for governed dispatch.
What should we dispatch next, and at what effort?
